content.text: {"verdicts":[{"check":"email_promises_uncommitted","artifact":"recap_email","target":"We will also include a free 90 day pilot with full support.","passed":false,"severity":"high","finding":"Nobody mentioned a pilot, free terms, or support anywhere in the call; this is an invented commercial commitment that would mislead the customer.","utterance_ids":["U030","U031"]},{"check":"quote_supports_claim","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Evidence: Ingest ran in about six minutes; twelve rows failed; paid and allowed amounts came in as text; Lily I can send it; Priya will send failed rows","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Each excerpt matches its line and supports the corresponding recap statement; Lily's offer to send her list is supported by U016.","utterance_ids":["U009","U013","U011","U016","U030","U031"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Priya will send the twelve failed rows and a short note on the two text columns today.","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"Matches Nate's U030 commitment and Priya's U031 'I'll send that today'; Nate's 'I'll reach out' is stated as reaching out about a time, not a scheduled meeting.","utterance_ids":["U030","U031","U028"]},{"check":"commitment_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Lily, thanks for offering to send your list so Priya can compare it against ours.","passed":false,"severity":"low","finding":"Lily said 'I can send it' but gave no date, and the email presents it as an offer with no date, which is acceptable; however the line also implies Lily's list is a confirmed deliverable and no due date was heard.","utterance_ids":["U016"]},{"check":"buying_signal_overstated","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Owen, I'll reach out about finding a time to finish the demo. Does the summary view match what you had in mind?","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The email does not claim any buying signal; it correctly leaves open Owen's lukewarm 'Sort of. I'd have to think about it.'","utterance_ids":["U020"]},{"check":"superseded_feature_as_current","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Freshness and feature claims in the recap","passed":true,"severity":"low","finding":"The email makes no claim about connector freshness or other release-card features; it mentions only the default-setup ingest and views shown.","utterance_ids":["U009","U017"]},{"check":"generic_step","artifact":"recap_email","target":"Owen, I'll reach out about finding a time to finish the demo.","passed":false,"severity":"medium","finding":"The follow-up is a generic 'reach out' with no proposed date, which fails PB-02's dated next meeting; Lily said Owen's calendar is a mess, so offering specific slots was needed.","utterance_ids":["U028","U029","U030"]}]}
